reviews.text: Jolly Plumbing exceeded my expectations! Their service was impressively fast, budget friendly, and truly professional from start to finish. They've quickly become my trusted go-to for all plumbing needs both now, and down the line. Big thanks to the team for making the whole experience seamless and stress free.

We had a devastating leak in our new house this morning on a Sunday. I had called one other place before Jolly and they told us they soonest they could get a plumber out was Tuesday. As you can see from the photos we couldn’t wait until Tuesday. I called Jolly and Hunter was super responsive and got someone out very quickly. Mike came out and was able to fix the leak and he was very Courteous. We will be using them in the future.

Called for an estimate. NOT a service call. No mention of payment beforehand. Was here for 15 min to take a few pictures. Charged double the price (of what?) because we “live too far”. That’s 32 miles from Keller to our house. We understand no one can “work for free” but you know you should disclose all charges before. Then let us decide if we want to proceed. Why didn’t you? Because NO ONE would agree to pay $200 for pictures. We’ve worked with Chester for years. Never had an issue. But we won’

UPDATE 8/28/24:  The repair done by Shawn and Jacob didn't last long. It broke because the installation was very poor, bending the pex lines to where the pex ruptured and failed, spraying water into the inside of my wall, destroying my wall. This poor repair wasn't under warranty after 2 years, so I had to pay for them to come repair the poor repair they made the first time, and now I have to replace my water soaked wall. If you use jolly plumbing, expect them to be out again in two years to fix

Great service by Chester and team. Found them on Google because of their high reviews. They definitely lived up to the high ratings. We received same day service too.The plumber, Austin was very professional and hard working.  I am extremely grateful they we able to fix the foundation slab leak. We will for sure be using them for our next plumbing issue.

I'd recommend no other plumbing company! We've used Jolly Plumbing for our last three plumbing needs in our home. The staff have always been responsive, professional, extremely knowledgable, dependable, and operate with high integrity. There's no need to look further, give these guys a call!

I needed an ice box valve replaced in the kitchen and called a few companies in the Keller area. Jolly Plumbing was the the best available to meet my scheduling needs. Shawn was quick to call me and setup a time to do the work. He was very professional and called on the day of service to tell me he was on his way. The quality of the work was very professional and he had all the tools he needed to do the work. The entire job was done in less than an hour. I will recommend Jolly Plumbing to my ent

I have used Jolly Plumbing multiple times over the last several years.  They are reliable, do a great job, are reasonably priced and are very quick to respond.  Chester and his crew are top notch and I will continue to use them in the future.  I highly recommend Jolly Plumbing, you won’t be disappointed!

They did it again!! Water heater stopped working. Had them come out and Chester took the time to explain everything and even call for the warranty with our water heater. Was very up front about the cost and why. Returned the next day with Adam and they were efficient and so timely. Kept me updated on everything they did and at the end once again educated me on everything. As female it was comforting that I wasn’t being talked down to, and felt very comfortable that I wasn’t being taken advantage

So, let me set the scene for you: 9 o'clock on a Saturday night, my housemate comes out of the bathroom yelling that her bathroom is clogged. We try in vain to move the clog. No dice. A store run, some Draino, and a lot of running water later, both bathrooms are clogged completely. So around 11:30, I call the number of a plumber a family member had recommended a while ago, thinking I'll get a voicemail and might hear back Monday morning since it's not an emergency.
Nope, I've got Hunter at my do

When I called Jolly Plumbing I was able to speak to Chester, unlike the other larger companies I tried calling.  I explained my issue to Chester over the phone & he was able to tell me the way to keep the water from filling the tank.  Then within just about an hour they

Woke up to our downstairs flooding, and not being able to turn our water off because we’re dumb young 1st house owners. Thank goodness for Jolly Plumbing!! Spoke with Hunter who informed me they couldn’t get a guy as quick as he thought. So he came himself! I appreciate the urgency as well as the information he gave us. Once hunter helped us getting the water turned off he got Micheal sent out to us shortly after. Micheal was great!! Once again educated us on everything going on and happening. W
Jolly plumbing did an excellent job installing my tankless gas water heaters, changing from electric tanks to gas

I have used Jolly Plumbing twice and had great experience both times.  Chester and his team are timely, honest, and get the job done right.  We will definitely use Jolly Plumbing again and recommend them to our family and friends.

Jolly Plumbing was amazing!  My husband called them late afternoon on a Thursday for an issue with our water heater and they were able to fit us in their schedule the following day, completely accommodated my hectic work schedule, which was so helpful!  They were on time, efficient with their diagnostic and were able to fix our water heater on the spot.  The owner Chester Jolly fully explained all the required repairs to me and also gave me some very helpful suggestions to prevent problems like

I have used Jolly Plumbing for two major plumbing jobs several years apart.  I was impressed and totally satisfied the first time, so I reached out to them for the second.

They are very responsive,  professional,  knowledgable and do a fantastic job!

I would not hesitate to heartily recommend them for your plumbing needs!

This is my second experience with Jolly Plumbing and both times I've been beyond impressed and pleased. Chester and his team not only repaired a HUGE issue at my office but most recently also repaired my broken sewer line at home. The teams are friendly, efficient and punctual. They also all spoke highly of Jolly Plumbing and their owner, Chester. As a small business owner myself, I know the respect of your staff is the #1 way to tell the true bones of a company!

Spending money on 2 new hot water heaters was not my ideal situation however it had to be done and Jolly Plumbing was great! Chester answered all of my questions and went over my options. We gathered 3 bids for the replacement and ultimately chose Jolly due to competitive pricing and great front-end customer service. Chester stayed in communication with me throughout the entire process giving me updates on his timeline and progress. I highly recommend Chester and Jolly Plumbing and I will use th

First experience with Jolly after moving to Keller a couple weeks ago. Moved into the new house and had a pipe burst immediately. I called Jolly and Chester was quick to get someone out here. Shawn was very knowledgeable and made a solid repair job after we tracked down the leak in the wall. I wasn’t even thinking about it but Shawn mentioned I should really call a restoration company because of how much water he found. Well he was right, once the restoration company pulled more baseboards and d

I highly recommend Jolly Plumbing! After a long day we realized our hot water heater wasn't working at 8pm. We called Jolly Plumbing and they had someone to our house in an hour. They worked quickly and fixed the water heater. Chester made sure to find a cost effective solution so we didn't have to pay too much. Thank you so much Jolly Plumbing!

The iron sewer drains underneath our 50 year old house were pretty much rusted out and causing us to call for unclogging on a frequent basis. We decided to hire Jolly Plumbing because of the large number of positive reviews. We were not disappointed. Hunter and his crew came out the very next day and got started. We decided to replace all of the cast iron pipe under the house. Despite the bad weather they finished in about 8 days and did an excellent job. We will definitely hire them again for o

Jolly plumbing did a great job replacing my sewer pipe. They tunneled under the house and took care of it. Chester and Hunter were very friendly and honest about the repair and what needed to be done. Erin was able to setup my appointment in a quick and timely manner. Thanks Jolly plumbing for taking care of me!

We needed several plumbing jobs done at our house. We called and asked Jolly plumbing for an estimate.  Chester Jolly came out and gave me a fair estimate of the work to be completed, and said he could get started immediately. He had another worker arrive and they finished a complete toilet repair, new sink drain install, new kitchen faucet install, and 2 outside faucet installs in about 2 1/2 hours. We are very happy with the work they did. They are very tidy and clean up after their work. I wo

A couple years ago Jolly Plumbing came out to my house to re-install my new toilet because the last plumber did a terrible job. I met Chester through my son who had recommended him to me, and through his good workmanship and price I recommend him to others in the area and have! Thanks again and will use them again.

I contacted Jolly Plumbing after receiving a quote for replacing my kitchen faucet from another business that was way over priced.  Jolly Plumbing was exceptional in replying to my request, their pricing is reasonable and Shawn did an excellent job in repairing my faucet.  Shawn was super attentive to my concerns and answered all of my questions.  I will definitely use them for all of my plumbing needs going forward.

Jolly plumbing really saved the day for me!  Chester went the extra mile helping diagnosis the problem in advance using text pics which allowed me to purchase the replacement faucet before he even arrived.   Pricing and policies were explained in advance.

Chester arrived timely, completed the repair with extra attention to detail, and kept cost within the estimate.  Excellent service at a fair price;  I definitely have a new plumber!

After reading Goggle reviews to find a plumber to fix my issue, I came across Jolly Plumbing. I was very impressed by the reviews so I called them up. Quick response,  appointment scheduled & confirmed, prompt arrival, very mannerable, issue resolved, quality work!! I am very satisfied with the process and I recommend them with no hesitation! Thank you Chester!!

Jolly Plumbing (Chester) made a service call for a fast leaking shower head on July 4th without charging extra. Service was professional, fairly priced, friendly and handled in a timely fashion. I will definitely call Jolly Plumbing for all of my future plumbing needs and I highly recommend Jolly Plumbing.

I called Jolly Plumbing about a low water pressure and leaking issue with my kitchen faucet. I was going to have to wait the whole weekend before they could come and look at it. I was surprised to have Shawn arrive at my house today to resolve the issue. Shawn was courteous, professional and had my issue resolved in no time. I'm happy I chose Jolly Plumbing; they were able to work me in and fix my problem so I didn't have to wait the whole weekend. Thanks again.
Cannot recommend enough! Made a next day appointment and issue was quickly resolved. Tech was very knowledgeable and professional. I will definitely use them again for my plumbing needs!

I can’t say enough about Jolly Plumbing, they were excellent with me, I have used them twice. The guys were so sweet, kind, very professional, hard working, and honest. The pricing was more than fair and I am very grateful because I know how much worse it could have been. Highly recommended and I will use them again if needed.

If you are on a forever waiting list for plumber to repair your busted pipes from the snowpocalypse, give Jolly Plumbing a call! They were quick to respond, professional, and SUPER affordable! After 6 days of no water, getting the constant message "let me take your number and we'll call you back" and no ETA, loading up the family to go shower at the truck stop every night, we found Jolly Plumbing. And we finally have water again!! Shawn, you are our hero!! Thank you 🙂

Jolly Plumbing became my plumbing company of choice tonight.  We had a leak in a line from our water heater and needed help.  They finished the job they were on and came right out to our location.  They were genuinely concerned and made a point to fix our problem tonight.  They are very professional, courteous, and friendly.  Thank You Jolly Plumbing!

I have used Jolly plumbing several times at different properties. They do fantastic work. Honest, fair, timely, quality workmanship, personable, price conscious. My latest interaction was at my home. One of my water heaters went out. They ordered all the parts, had them delivered, and came over on the weekend to perform the replacement. They hauled off the old water heater, replaced some parts on the other water heater that weren't up to today's code, and overall made things safer and more effic

Sean and Jacob replaced our water heater last week. They were very professional, very careful and very friendly too. They took time to make sure everything was perfect and they cleaned up nicely. Very impressed with their work. Great mannerisms. Will use them any day. Good job gentlemen. Lots of blessings on y’all and the business. Thanks Jolly. 🙏🏼

Jolly plumbing is without a doubt the best.!!! Chester himself responded quick to my emergency, him and Darrell work amazing together. Not only are they very knowledgeable they are quick and most importantly they are HONEST, treated as if I was a family member. If you are looking for the full package then I refer you to them, also very reasonable price. Never write reviews but I know how hard it is to find good help and honest help. Oh and one more thing not only are they the best and so hard wo

Cant say enough good things about Jolly plumbing. Chester and his guys are professional, reliable, friendly, and they stand behind their work. If you need a plumber don't hesitate to call. You won't be disappointed.

We appreciate Jolly Plumbing for everything, we have been working for him for 4 years. Never had an issue with a customer. (They always love the work we do) Jolly Plumbing has always been on time to each and every job we have done for him. I recommend him 100%, he's a respectful and a profesional plumber..

I just want to give Jolly plumbing a hands up on the great job they did for us at our rental house!! We had clients coming in to stay for a week and we had a emergency water leak going on. It was to late to cancel the clients but Chester came and met me at the residence property and rescued us from a disaster! He was on time and explained everything to me and got us situated! I highly recommend Jolly’s plumbing to anyone!! Thanks again Chester for coming through for us!!

Customer service with Jolly Plumbing was awesome. I called and spoke with Chester just after lunch and he was able to fit me in that same day. I was selling my house and had a plumber visit to complete a fresh water test. That test failed due to a minor leak and that plumber couldn't find the issue and recommended that I get another specialist out to do additional testing that would cost me $800 just for the test. I called Jolly Plumbing and explained the situation to Chester and he understood t

Chester came to our rescue after moving into a brand new home. He came out the next day after I called him on a Sunday night. Even came over late to fit us in. Plus stayed late to get our plumbing working for us. I can't not even explain how helpful and knowledgable he was. Plus one of the nicest people. If you need a plumber Jolly Plumbing is definitely who you need to call.

These guys came out during a recent winter storm and did an amazing job on a full commode re-install and foundation repair. They were very professional, personal and worked with exceptional service skills. One plumber was injured outdoors from an icy driveway slip, and still continued to finish the job and cleanup. Can’t recommend these guys enough. If you want a good local hometown plumber, thIs is your business to contact!

Excellent customer service at fair price. I felt comfortable having them at our home while my husband was at work-very polite and knowledgeable. Our plumbing issue ended up being the city’s responsibility which Jolly Plumbing informed us of-very much appreciate their honesty! Highly recommend.

Very BAD experience! Hunter quoted me $650 to hook up two bathroom faucets/sinks. After being told I was on the schedule for Thursday nobody came, then told I was down for Friday. Again nobody showed up at 9 like told, I called and Hunter said he had me mixed up with another person and thought it was Monday.
Finally, Johnnie showed up did the work which he was very nice, once he finished I was presented me with a bill for $1,620. I could not believe the lack of communication. I still had to pay

Jolly Plumbing is our go to when we have any plumbing issues. The company is very reliable and trustworthy. We've even had them out to do service at my dad's house after another plumber did a terrible job. Chester came out and fixed the issues!!

Chester did a great job at my business.  Jolly plumbing is punctual, straight forward, and timely.  They do excellent work and honor their warranty.  I would hire Jolly plumber for all my future plumbing needs.

I have used them for 3 major projects to date, and not only plan to use them in the future, but I refuse to use anyone else.

Hired Jolly plumbing to replace kitchen faucet. Chester came by on a Saturday and handled it. He was professional and cleaned up properly after the work. Gave us helpful tips on how to maintain certain items. We will hire him again.
